profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cisco
profile.summary:
- Expertise in service-oriented architecture, web services, cross-platform and distributed systems.
- Hands-on experience in continuous integration and containers.
- Adept in Collaborating with other teams.
- Experience in working and managing multiple projects in different languages simultaneously.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
• Joined as Associate system engineer, to develop, maintain, and enhance existing systems, and participate in analysis and design of new systems.
• Hands on experience with SQL database and the underlying Linux platform.
• Served as C/C++ backend developer dealing with Software analysis, Bug fix, Test runs, Deployment and code enhancements of Client Application.
• Practiced Agile methodologies like standup, sprint planning, retrospective.
• Build results were published into Jenkins and code build was done in docker environment.
• Experience in production support, including problem identification, ticket documentation, and resolving defect tickets.
• Skills: C/C++, excellent debugging skills, .NET, SQL, LINUX
• Tools: Service Now, PPM (Project Management Tool)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
𝐃𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐫 𝐏𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦 (𝐊𝐮𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐬, 𝐆𝐨𝐋𝐚𝐧𝐠, 𝐇𝐞𝐥𝐦/𝐇𝐞𝐥𝐦𝐟𝐢𝐥𝐞, 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐮𝐬, 𝐆𝐫𝐚𝐟𝐚𝐧𝐚, 𝐁𝐚𝐬𝐡)

Building the core runtime platform for deploying microservices on multi-cloud Kubernetes clusters globally to speed up time to market and quality of apps

Built the API gateway using Nginx Ingress controller + CertManager/LetsEncrypt with TLS termination at Ingress and automatic certificate rotation for secure access to services deployed on Kubernetes

Worked on deprecating the current API Gateway - Kong and handled migrations to the new Gateway

Building Infrastructure as Code pipelines with Terraform at WeWork and streamline the process of deploying distributed cloud computing application on various platforms like AWS, AliCloud and Heroku
